text: great here is another thing, so the uv editor where u map to the texture needs to let the uv be able to travel off the image because i keep having problems where i hit an edge during a linked mesh and it just wont move because its hitting the wall. its painful
resolution: The UV editor now treats the texture rectangle as a sampling region inside a signed pannable workspace: islands, linked selections, faces, vertices, transforms, and stitches can cross every image edge. The native exact-corner boundary preserves those coordinates, and finite model-atlas samples outside the image alpha-discard in Scene3D while ordinary material sampling stays unchanged. Signed movement, off-image editing, grid, native paint, and shader-contract regressions cover the behavior.
